name: Ezra Klein
role: American journalist and New York Times opinion columnist; podcast host; co-author of Abundance
summary: Klein is a liberal journalist who supports universal healthcare and democratic reform of American institutions (ending the filibuster and electoral college, proportional representation). His recent work argues liberals should make building housing, clean energy and transit easier by cutting procedural obstacles.
